active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_captu.does: Text of slot 6 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 6). Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_charg.does: Delay in ms before the shelf display mode is changed. The device-state handler starts debouncedSetShelfDisplayMode with this value; a newer change cancels the pending one.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_demo_.does: Colour name mapped to an LED id. 'orange' maps to 123. An unknown name logs a warning and the LED indicator is disabled.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_demo_.change: Only 'orange' is shown in the code given. Any other name not in the switch disables the LED indicator.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_disab.does: When on, the pairing education TTS is skipped, logged as 'Skipping pairing TTS - disabled via MobileConfig'. When off, the TTS plays.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_don_d.change: Sets the debounce part of the larger value. The earcon value can lengthen the wait if it is larger.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_don_e.does: Earcon duration. It enters the DON debounce as max(debounce, earcon) (see sg_don_debounce_ms), logged as 'earcon='.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_don_e.change: Lengthens the DON debounce only when it is larger than sg_don_debounce_ms.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.does: When on and no demo ATC client exists, the handler creates ActiveGlassesDemoAtcClient and reads the C0N5 provider. The key is 4630012314511540224, which is this param's id in MobileConfigParams.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.change: On: the demo ATC client is created. Off (now): it is not created.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.does: When on, the LED update runs. It sets LED notification id 124 when the battery is at or below sg_low_battery_threshold, otherwise 122.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.change: Off: the LED update returns without doing anything.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.does: When on, the server demo session branch runs. It logs 'Server demo session MC enabled=' and reads the C0N5 provider's config. What that branch does next is not in the code given.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.change: On: the server-session branch is taken.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_enabl.does: When on, a session watchdog coroutine (C0fL task 28) is started and logged as 'Session watchdog enabled via MobileConfig'. What the watchdog checks is not in the code given.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_fade_.does: Step interval in ms for a volume fade. WavAudioPlayer's fade thread sleeps this long between volume updates. The value is passed to the WavAudioPlayer constructor in two audio setups.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_fade_.change: Sets the sleep between fade volume steps. Smaller values make the fade update more often.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_genre.does: Text of slot 2 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 2), used in the music step. Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_genre.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_genre.does: Text of slot 3 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 3), the retry for the music step. Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_genre.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_is_re.does: Read by AbstractC03260Mq.A00(), which logs the value and returns false on a read error. When on, the pairing education coordinator skips the pairing TTS on the retail demo device.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_is_re.change: On: the pairing education TTS is skipped as a retail demo device. Off is the normal state.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_low_b.does: Battery percentage threshold. A battery change that crosses it, while the glasses are idle, triggers the LED update. The LED update uses it to choose LED id 124 or 122.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_low_b.change: Sets the battery level at which the idle LED switches to id 124.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_max_c.does: After this many consecutive empty dictation results, the handler logs 'Max consecutive dictation failures reached' and aborts the Q&A session.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_max_c.change: Sets how many empty dictation results in a row end the Q&A session.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.does: Text of slot 9 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 9). Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.does: Text of slot 8 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 8). Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.does: Text of slot 11 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 11), the retry for the Meta AI step. Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.does: Text of slot 10 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 10). Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.does: Text of slot 12 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 12), used when the Meta AI question is not recognized. Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_meta_.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.does: Starts audio resource 0 and then waits this many ms before the step continues.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.change: Sets how long the step waits after the music resource starts.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.does: Fade-in length. The music player volume is set to 0 and the resource starts, then WavAudioPlayer.A03 fades the volume to its target over this many ms.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.change: Sets the fade-in length of the music.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.does: Fade-out length. When the server demo stops the background bed (topic_exit), WavAudioPlayer.A09 fades the volume to 0 over this many ms.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.change: Sets the fade-out length when the background music stops.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.does: Music volume as a percent. The handler sets the WavAudioPlayer volume to value / 100 (0.70 now). WavAudioPlayer.A07 clamps it to 0 to 1 and sets the AudioTrack volume.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_music.change: Sets the music player volume, 0 to 100 percent.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_oacr_.does: Dictation timeout. The dictation step starts with this timeout (logged in seconds). A dictation that times out is logged as 'Dictation timed out after N ms, abandoning' and counts as an empty result.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_oacr_.change: Sets how long the Q&A dictation listens before it gives up.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_qa_sc.does: Selects the demo scenario ID. The system property persist.activeglasses.qa_scenario is used first when set. Otherwise this MC value is used, and if it is empty the ID is 'default'.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_qa_sc.change: A scenario ID other than 'default' loads the built-in scenario from C0Mz.A01, and the MC speech strings are not used.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_topic.does: Comma-separated list of topic names for the default scenario. It is split on commas, empty entries are dropped, and each name is checked against the step map in that order.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_topic.change: Changes which topics run and their order in the default scenario. Unknown names are checked against the step map at C0Mz.java:71-72.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_tts_m.does: TTS voice for the Meta AI line. The Settings.Global override 'sg_tts_meta_ai_voice_id' is used first when set. Otherwise this MC value is used if non-empty, else the default voice. A read error gives the default.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_tts_m.change: A non-empty Settings.Global override replaces this value.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_tts_s.does: Speed passed to the TTS request. The value is passed as the first argument of TtsRepositoryImpl.A01, which is stored as $speed. A value of 0 or less is passed as null.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_tts_s.change: Sets the TTS speed for demo speech. 0 or less sends no speed.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_tts_v.does: TTS voice id for demo speech. The Settings.Global override 'sg_tts_voice_id' is used first when set. Otherwise this MC value is used if non-empty, else the default voice. A read error gives the default.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_tts_v.change: A non-empty Settings.Global override replaces this value.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_volum.does: Text of slot 4 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 4), the volume step prompt. Used only when the scenario ID is 'default' or empty.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_volum.change: Replaces the text of that slot in the default scenario.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_volum.does: Timeout in ms for the wait for a volume change. The step logs 'Playing audio and waiting for volume change (timeout: N ms)' with this value.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_volum.change: Sets how long the demo waits for a volume change before moving on.

active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_welco.does: Text of slot 1 of the default demo scenario (C0Mz.A00 argument 1), the welcome. It contains a {model_name} placeholder. Where the placeholder is filled in is not in the code given.
active_glasses_demo_sessionless.sg_welco.change: Replaces the welcome text of the default scenario.

appmanager_sn_sessioned.aging_maximum_th.does: Read as a long and used as the aging maximum SOC threshold only if it is 1 to 100. Otherwise the code uses 100. It is logged as 'Aging maximum SOC threshold: %d (MC value: %ld)'.
appmanager_sn_sessioned.aging_maximum_th.change: A value outside 1 to 100 is replaced by 100.

appmanager_sn_sessioned.disable_call_rej.does: isCallRejectionWhileDoffedEnabled() returns the inverse of this flag (mov w8,#1; bic w0,w8,w0). The caller is not in the code given.

appmanager_sn_sessioned.earcon_music_vol.does: Read in Volume.getMusicToNotificationVolumeStepDistance(), code default 0. SgVolumeController.calculateNotificationVolumeFromMusicVolume passes it to Volume.getVolumePercentageNStepDistance() when converting music volume to notification volume.
appmanager_sn_sessioned.earcon_music_vol.change: The value is the step distance used in that music-to-notification conversion. The code does not show the resulting volume numbers.

appmanager_sn_sessioned.enable_wake_gest.does: Read as enableHandTracking in SmartglassesConfig and GlobalInputFilterGating. GlobalInputFilterLogic.onMobileConfigFetched sets the system property sys.settings.enable_alwaysoncamera to match it when they differ. SmartglassesEffects observes the value.
appmanager_sn_sessioned.enable_wake_gest.change: The code copies the value into sys.settings.enable_alwaysoncamera. The code does not show what the always-on camera then does.

ar_assisted_demo.assisted_demo_hn_screen.does: Read in SgDisplayMobileConfigClient.screenOffTimeoutRetailDemoMobileConfigVal(), code default 120000 ms. When retail demo mode is on, SgDisplayScreenOffTimeoutHandler writes it to Settings.System screen_off_timeout.
ar_assisted_demo.assisted_demo_hn_screen.change: Sets the screen-off timeout in ms used while retail demo mode is on.

ar_passive_phone_unlock.allow_multiple_v.does: Read as the fallback when the system property persist.allow_multiple_verified_session_requests is not set (C08N.A00: property wins if set to 1 or true). When true, a new verified-session request replaces the stored callback. When false, a new request is ignored while one is pending.
ar_passive_phone_unlock.allow_multiple_v.change: Off: a second request is refused while the first is pending.

ar_wearables_latency.image_stream_use_hi.does: In sharingservice, the image stream is set to high priority when this flag is on, or when assistant_warp_use_warp_idnm is on. The log is 'Set image stream priority to high: %s'.
ar_wearables_latency.image_stream_use_hi.change: On (or assistant_warp_use_warp_idnm on): the image stream is set to high priority.

assistant_on_hn.ai_home_enabled.does: Read in AssistantAppMobileConfigs and passed as the second argument of new C0FC(z2, flag). Native code in the assistant binary reads the same id and, when it is set, logs that a double thumb tap on an active assistant is not canceling it. When clear, that branch is skipped.
assistant_on_hn.ai_home_enabled.change: On: the double thumb tap on an active assistant takes the branch that logs 'not canceling assistant'. Off: that branch is skipped. The rest of the path is not shown.

assistant_on_hn.auto_start_template_chan.does: When set, AssistantTemplateRepository calls startObserveAssistantState() during its init. When clear, it does not.
assistant_on_hn.auto_start_template_chan.change: On: assistant state observation starts when the template repository is set up.

assistant_on_hn.hn_live_ai_cache_client_.does: LiveAiService: when the flag is clear it logs 'Frame caching is not enabled via mobile config' and returns. When set, it goes on to a second dispatch (C0Q4.A03 with id 10) for the frame cache.
assistant_on_hn.hn_live_ai_cache_client_.change: On: the frame caching dispatch runs.

assistant_on_hn.live_ai_image_res_height.does: LiveAiService.A01 uses this value as the height argument of ImageReader.newInstance(width, height, 35, 6) for frame capture, and logs 'Setting up Assistant frame capture: WxH'.
assistant_on_hn.live_ai_image_res_height.change: Sets the height of the Live AI / Assistant frame capture image reader.

assistant_on_hn.live_ai_image_res_width.does: LiveAiService.A01 uses this value as the width argument of ImageReader.newInstance(width, height, 35, 6) for frame capture, and logs it in 'Setting up Assistant frame capture: WxH'.
assistant_on_hn.live_ai_image_res_width.change: Sets the width of the Live AI / Assistant frame capture image reader.

assistant_on_hn.mmllm_mid_size_snapshot_.does: When the privacy LED is on, the code logs 'Privacy LED is enabled, using default snapshot height' and uses a default height. Otherwise it reads this value as a long (id 0x70510000 in the fe3 space) and uses it.
assistant_on_hn.mmllm_mid_size_snapshot_.change: Changes the snapshot height only when the privacy LED is off.

assistant_on_hn.mmllm_mid_size_snapshot_.does: When the privacy LED is on, the code logs 'Privacy LED is enabled, using default snapshot width' and uses a default width. Otherwise it reads this value as a long (id 0x70520000 in the fe3 space) and uses it.
assistant_on_hn.mmllm_mid_size_snapshot_.change: Changes the snapshot width only when the privacy LED is off.

assistant_on_hn.use_mapless_template.does: When C0F6.A03 is set and the template is opened from navigation, getBackgroundAvailabilityOverride returns a persistence of 300000 ms (5 minutes) for template type 18. Otherwise it returns null.
assistant_on_hn.use_mapless_template.change: On: templates of type 18 opened from navigation stay available in the background for 5 minutes.

assistant_on_hn.use_wakeword_hal.does: When set, the code logs 'Wakeword HAL enabled by mobile config'. When clear, it logs 'Wakeword HAL disabled by mobile config'. The wake word path itself is not in the code shown.

assistant_on_sn.assistant_shutdown_waiti.does: Read as a long (id 0x72b90000 in the be5 space) at shutdown, and logged as 'assistant service shutdown maxloopcount: {}' in ShutdownerImpl.cpp.

assistant_on_sn.btc_device_connected_ann.does: In onBtcConnected, the companion app launch call runs first, then the flag is read (id 0x70740000 in the be5 space). When clear, it logs 'Not announcing BTC connected. MC disabled.' and skips the announce. When set and the device is not primary, the code takes the announce path (not shown). When primary, it logs 'Not announcing BTC connected since its the primary device.'
assistant_on_sn.btc_device_connected_ann.change: On: a BTC device that is not primary is announced.

assistant_on_sn.default_asr_timeout_s.does: Read by getter key 0x44 (68) through getter 0x155e0ac. The timeout is adjusted by VAD. If the result is not positive, the code logs 'ASR timeout became non-positive after VAD adjustment ({}s). Skipping ASR.'

assistant_on_sn.music_pt_integration_ena.does: When on, the assistant registers an AVRCP handler (setAvrcpHandler) on ARWirelessServiceProvider. When off, that call is skipped. setBtcHandler runs either way.
assistant_on_sn.music_pt_integration_ena.change: On: the AVRCP handler is registered with the wireless service provider. Off: it is not.

audio_on_xn.call_rejection_on_mount_chan.does: Read as SgAudioManagerMobileConfigClient.isCallRejectionOnMountChangeEnabled() (code default true; glasses value false). SgAudioPolicyController stores it and uses it on mount change: it logs call disconnects on doff and passes it as the shouldDisconnectAudioOnDoff argument of routeHfpCall. MecCallRoutingController passes it into decideRouting.
audio_on_xn.call_rejection_on_mount_chan.change: When true, an active call's HFP audio is disconnected from the glasses on doff (routeHfpCall, mount-change path). When false, that path does not disconnect for doff in that call.

audio_on_xn.call_rejection_while_doffed_.does: Read as SgAudioManagerMobileConfigClient.isCallRejectionWhileDoffedEnabled() (code default true; glasses value true). SgAudioPolicyController stores it and passes it as shouldDisconnectAudioOnDoff to routeHfpCall. MecCallRoutingController passes it into decideRouting, which has a RINGING_REJECTED_BY_DOFF state.
audio_on_xn.call_rejection_while_doffed_.change: When true, a call taken while the glasses are doffed is routed away from the glasses (HFP disconnected). When false, that routeHfpCall disconnect path is skipped.

audio_on_xn.video_capture_music_concurre.does: Read in SgAudioManagerMobileConfigClient.getVideoCaptureMusicConcurrencyDuckingDurationMs() (MC default 0; code fallback 3000). SgAudioPolicyController stores it in mVideoCaptureConcurrencyDuckDelayMs and writes system property persist.audio.video_capture_music_duck_delay_ms.
audio_on_xn.video_capture_music_concurre.change: Sets the delay used for ducking music during video capture, through the persist.audio.video_capture_music_duck_delay_ms property. The code does not show the audio stack that reads that property.

audio_on_xn.video_capture_music_concurre.does: Read in SgAudioManagerMobileConfigClient.getVideoCaptureMusicConcurrencyMuteDurationMs() (MC default 0; code fallback 0). SgAudioPolicyController stores it in mVideoCaptureConcurrencyMuteDurationMs and writes system property persist.audio.video_capture_music_mute_duration_ms.
audio_on_xn.video_capture_music_concurre.change: Sets the mute duration for music during video capture, through the persist.audio.video_capture_music_mute_duration_ms property. The code does not show the reader of that property.

audio_on_xn.xn_leak_crusher.does: Read as SgAudioManagerMobileConfigClient.isLeakCrusherGKEnabled() (code default false). It gates the leak-crusher setting: SgAudioServerController.setLeakCrusherSettingChange returns early when the gate is off, and setLeakCrusherIntensity does nothing when off.
audio_on_xn.xn_leak_crusher.change: When on, the user's leak crusher setting is accepted, and can be turned on and tuned (intensity). When off, those setting changes are dropped.

audio_on_xn.xn_music_concurrency.does: Read as isMusicConcurrencyGKEnabled() (code default false). SgAudioPolicyController stores it in mIsMusicConcurrencyGKEnabled. On camera and autocapture session state it decides the music-concurrency state, unless live-AI decoupling picks the interactive flag instead.
audio_on_xn.xn_music_concurrency.change: When on, music concurrency is allowed for these sessions. When off, that path does not use it.

audio_on_xn.xn_music_concurrency_interac.does: Read as isInteractiveAutocaptureMusicConcurrencyGKEnabled() (code default false). In SgAudioPolicyController, when this is off shouldSkipDuckingForInteractiveAutocapture returns false (no skip). It also selects the music-concurrency state during interactive autocapture sessions when live-AI decoupling applies.
audio_on_xn.xn_music_concurrency_interac.change: When on, music ducking can be skipped for interactive autocapture (for example Live AI running, so music is not paused). When off, that skip does not apply.

audio_on_xn.xn_music_concurrency_v2.does: Read as isMusicConcurrencyV2GKEnabled() (code default false; glasses value true). Gates the video-capture music mute/duck policy in SgAudioPolicyController (camera capture start) and the setMusicConcurrency call in SgAudioServerController.setMusicConcurrencySettingChange.
audio_on_xn.xn_music_concurrency_v2.change: When on, video capture ducks or mutes music per the v2 policy and the user's music-concurrency setting is applied. When off, those calls are skipped.

audio_on_xn.xn_spatial_media.does: Read as isSpatialMediaGKEnabled() (code default false). SgAudioServerController.setSpatialMediaSettingChange sends message 31 or 32 only when the gate is on. When off and the user setting is true, it logs that xn_spatial_media MC is off and does nothing.
audio_on_xn.xn_spatial_media.change: When on, the user's spatial media setting is applied to the audio server. When off, the setting is ignored.

audio_on_xn.xn_water_detect.does: Read as isWaterDetectGKEnabled() (code default false). SgWaterIngressController.notifyWaterDetected does its work only when the gate is on: it logs a water_detected analytics event and passes the water-detected state on.
audio_on_xn.xn_water_detect.change: When on, water-ingress detection events are handled and logged. When off, notifyWaterDetected does nothing.

audio_on_xn.xn_water_detect_tts.does: Read as isWaterDetectTTSEnabled() (code default false). SgWaterIngressController plays the WATER_INGRESS_DETECTED_TTS earcon when water is detected and this gate is on.
audio_on_xn.xn_water_detect_tts.change: When on, a water-detected event plays the water ingress detected TTS earcon. When off, that earcon is not played.

autocapture_on_sn.allow_arbitrary_smart_.does: When the watch type is not allowed, the code falls back to 'Garmin' and logs 'Smart watch type not allowed: <type>, falling back to Garmin'. The allowed check is c01510Cm.A00.A03.A01(C0Cv.A00) OR the known list AbstractC01570Da.A00.
autocapture_on_sn.allow_arbitrary_smart_.change: On: the watch type passes the first check and is kept. Off: only known names are accepted.

autocapture_on_sn.default_video_length.does: When the per-trigger override is null, AutoCaptureTriggerManagerImpl sets the video duration to this value * 1000 ms and passes it as CAPTURE_VIDEO_DURATION for video captures.

autocapture_on_sn.delayed_trigger_max_de.does: A delayed trigger is dropped with reason 'Exceeded max delay time' when the time since it was created is larger than this value.
autocapture_on_sn.delayed_trigger_max_de.change: A larger value keeps older delayed triggers alive.

autocapture_on_sn.first_time_user_ed_cou.does: The first-time autocapture earcon education plays while the stored count (SharedPreferences 'first_time_user_ed_count') is below this value, and the count is then incremented.

autocapture_on_sn.glasses_skip_cloud_med.does: PhoneBasedExperience.handleFailure returns false and logs 'Skipping CLOUD_MEDIA_DISABLED error' when this flag is on, so that failure is not reported.

autocapture_on_sn.hinges_closed_timer.does: When the value is not 0, schedules the HINGE_CLOSED_TIMEOUT alarm for this many ms and logs 'Starting hinge closed timer'.

autocapture_on_sn.live_ai_decoupling_ena.does: When on, AutoCaptureManagerImpl builds the Live AI coupling C04S (with WearableConcurrencyManager); when off it builds C04n. It also gates a wake lock 'AutoCapture::InteractiveStreamWakeLock' in the interactive experience.

autocapture_on_sn.mmai_during_autocaptur.does: Selects whether the Live AI coupling is given the WearableConcurrencyManager: when on, the context's WearableConcurrencyManager is passed to C04S; when off it is null.

autocapture_on_sn.pause_reminder_timeout.does: When > 0, schedules the PAUSE_REMINDER alarm for this many ms; the callback plays the pause reminder earcon. 0 schedules no reminder.
autocapture_on_sn.pause_reminder_timeout.change: A few minutes would fire the reminder during a pause, per the code path.

autocapture_on_sn.reconnect_max_retry_at.does: AutoCaptureDataXClient stops reconnecting after this many attempts: 'ConnectionClosedTimeout: Maximum retries reached, stop attempting to reconnect'; the recovery path gives up with 'recovery budget exhausted'.
autocapture_on_sn.reconnect_max_retry_at.change: More attempts keep the client retrying longer.

autocapture_on_sn.starting_chime_enabled.does: When on, playing the start/resume earcon plays sound id 23 (C0Q4.A06 with 23) when the session starts or resumes.
autocapture_on_sn.starting_chime_enabled.change: On plays the chime on start; off keeps the start silent (the current setting).

capture_on_assistant.meta_ai_queries_dur.does: Meta AI queries during capture are allowed only when this reads true (isMetaAiConcurrencyDuringCaptureEnabled). If the read fails, the gate logs 'Failed to read MetaAiQueriesDuringCapture mobile config, defaulting to concurrency disabled'.
capture_on_assistant.meta_ai_queries_dur.change: On allows Meta AI queries while capture runs; off keeps the concurrency gate closed.

input_on_hn.emg_double_tap_delay_ms.change: The value is the wait in ms before a single EMG tap is emitted. Larger gives more time for a second tap; smaller makes single taps fire sooner.

input_on_hn.emg_wrist_roll_for_universal.does: When off, key events 24 and 25 (volume up/down) from the EMG wrist roll are dropped before handleKeyEvent. input_on_hn.hn_enable_2d_imu_on_launcher.change: On applies the XY-axis lock expansion on the launcher. Off is the current setting.

input_on_hn.smartglass_simplified_dismis.does: Remaps single captouch taps in GlobalInputFilterLogic (SmartglassesConfig.getSmartglassSimplifiedDismissalCaptouch(), MobileConfig, default false, property persist.input.smartglass_simplified_dismissal_captouch). input_on_hn.smartglass_simplified_dismis.change: On makes a one-finger single tap dismiss a ringing call (as a double tap) and act as a hold while the assistant is active. Off is the current setting.

input_on_hn.smartglass_simplified_dismis.does: HN version of the simplified dismissal (SmartglassesConfig.getSmartglassSimplifiedDismissalCaptouchHN(), MobileConfig, default false, property persist.input.smartglass_simplified_dismissal_captouch_hn). input_on_hn.smartglass_simplified_dismis.change: On makes a one-finger tap (play/pause keycode 85) accept a ringing call and dismiss assistant TTS when the display is off. Off is the current setting.

input_on_hn.wearable_enable_wrist_roll_s.does: SmartglassesConfig.getWearableEnableWristRollSystemVolume() (MobileConfig, default false, property persist.settings.wearable_enable_wrist_roll_system_volume) is one of the conditions in GlobalInputFilterLogic that decide whether wrist-roll input goes to the system volume handler. music_concurrency_behaviors.meta_wearabl.change: Set to 0 or more to enable the resume window, in ms since the pause. Set below 0 to disable it. The glasses have -1.0 (disabled).

power_state_hn.deep_sleep_check_imu.does: Sets DeepSleepHandler.mCheckImuStateForDeepSleep (constructed true; overwritten at boot phase 550 with SgPowerMobileConfigClient.isDeepSleepCheckImuEnabled(), which is MC (default false) OR system property persist.settings.deep_sleep_check_imu_enabled). power_state_hn.deep_sleep_check_imu.change: On requires the IMU state to be 1 before a mounted glasses state counts toward deep sleep. Off skips that IMU check. The glasses have false.

power_state_hn.deep_sleep_timeout_ms.does: DeepSleepHandler.getDeepSleepTimeout(): system property sys.settings.deepsleeptimeout (minutes) wins if above 0. power_state_hn.deep_sleep_timeout_ms.change: Sets the deep sleep timer length in ms. Unset or 0 keeps 20 minutes. The glasses have it unset (None).

power_state_hn.hibernate_abl_restore_ena.does: SgPowerMobileConfigClient.isHibernateAblRestoreEnabled() = MC (default false) OR system property persist.sys.meta.hibernate_abl_restore_enabled. In HibernateHandler, when on, the hibernation service is used with restore type set to "abl" and the power state service is not used. The dump reports hibernate version 2 when on, 1 when off.
power_state_hn.hibernate_abl_restore_ena.change: On selects the ABL restore path for hibernate (hibernate version 2 in the dump). Off is the current setting.

power_state_hn.hibernate_bt_watchdog_tim.does: SgPowerMobileConfigClient.getBTWatchdogTimeoutS() returns the MC value, falling back to 60 s if unset. HibernateHandler uses it when turning Bluetooth on after resume: it waits up to this many seconds for the Bluetooth adapter, retrying every 1 s.
power_state_hn.hibernate_bt_watchdog_tim.change: Sets how many seconds the hibernate resume waits for the Bluetooth adapter. The glasses have 15.

power_state_hn.hibernate_deep_sleep_enab.does: SgPowerMobileConfigClient.isHibernateDeepSleepEnabled() = MC (default false) OR system property persist.sys.meta.hibernate_deep_sleep_enabled. In HibernateHandler, deep-sleep hibernate is allowed when hibernate_por_all is on, or when hibernate_enabled and this flag are both on. canHibernate refuses the shutdown,deep_sleep reasons otherwise.
power_state_hn.hibernate_deep_sleep_enab.change: On allows hibernate from the deep sleep reasons (shutdown,deep_sleep and the hinge variants), but only with hibernate_enabled on (or hibernate_por_all). Off is the current setting.

power_state_hn.hibernate_enabled.does: SgPowerMobileConfigClient.isHibernateEnabled() = MC (default false) OR system property persist.sys.meta.hibernate_enabled. HibernateHandler stores it as mHibernateMCEnabled. The power-slider check requires it on, and deep sleep requires it unless hibernate_por_all is on.
power_state_hn.hibernate_enabled.change: On is the master switch for the power-slider hibernate reason and for deep-sleep hibernate unless por_all is on. Off is the current setting.

power_state_hn.hibernate_por_all_enabled.does: SgPowerMobileConfigClient.isHibernatePorAllEnabled() is true when MC (default false) or the system property persist.sys.meta.hibernate_por_all_enabled is on. It is also true when hibernate_enabled, deep_sleep and smart_charging are all on. In HibernateHandler, por_all lets deep sleep and smart charging hibernate without hibernate_enabled.
power_state_hn.hibernate_por_all_enabled.change: On enables deep-sleep and smart-charging hibernate even when hibernate_enabled is off. The power-slider check does not use it. The glasses have it unset (None).

power_state_hn.hibernate_power_slider_en.does: SgPowerMobileConfigClient.isHibernatePowerSliderEnabled() = MC (default false) OR system property persist.sys.meta.hibernate_power_slider_enabled. In HibernateHandler the power-slider hibernate reason needs hibernate_enabled and this flag both on. por_all does not bypass it.
power_state_hn.hibernate_power_slider_en.change: On allows hibernate from the power slider reason (shutdown,power_slider), with hibernate_enabled on. Off is the current setting.

power_state_hn.hibernate_smart_charging_.does: Hibernate reason gate for the smart_charging shutdown state. HibernateHandler allows it when hibernate_por_all_enabled is on, or when hibernate_enabled and this flag are both on. When it is off, the shutdown reason "smart_charging" is refused with "smart_charging_not_enabled". Also a fallback sysprop persist.sys.meta.hibernate_smart_charging_enabled.
power_state_hn.hibernate_smart_charging_.change: Setting it true lets the smart_charging hibernate state run, provided hibernate_enabled is also true (or hibernate_por_all_enabled is true). Setting it false blocks that state.

power_state_hn.smart_charging_timeout_ms.does: Fallback smart-charging timer length in ms. getSmartChargingTimeoutMs() uses the sysprop sys.settings.smart_charging_timeout first (minutes, if above 0); otherwise this value if above 0; otherwise the built-in mSmartChargingDefaultTimerLengthMs.
power_state_hn.smart_charging_timeout_ms.change: A value above 0 replaces the built-in default timer length; 0 or less keeps the default.

WearableConcurrencyArbitratorGating.isConcurrencyV2Enabled() reads that property ('true' or '1' is on). wearable_feature_specific_device_state_s.change: On (with calling-state on): the call id is sent with the device state.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_3p_active_cal.does: Flag C0XY.A04 (the name is not shown in these lines). (AbstractC02270Vg.java:195).
wearable_hn_calling.enable_3p_active_cal.change: On: invalid HFP calls go through this block (non-terminal ones become state 7). Off: the block does not run.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_avatar.does: Read as a bool (C0XY.A06). It gates the codec avatar toggle in the call controls: the toggle is shown only when this is on, the service is not zA0Z, and two other states hold (InCallViewModel.java:149). wearable_hn_calling.enable_captions.change: Off: no captions toggle in the call controls.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_extended_outg.does: For AI-glasses calls with this flag on, the outgoing call timeout is outgoing_call_request_timeout_ms_on_sn (item 17). If that value is 0 or less, the on_hn value (item 16, code default 20000 ms) is used.
wearable_hn_calling.enable_extended_outg.change: On: the SN timeout replaces the default for AI glasses. Off: that branch is not taken; the default is not in this code.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_live_captions.does: Empties the service list used by the captions gate (item 6). With it on, the captions toggle is offered for every service; with it off, only for services outside the list of messenger, IG, WhatsApp and HFP services.
wearable_hn_calling.enable_live_captions.change: Off: captions toggle only for services outside that list.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_relay_as_tran.does: For AI and display glasses, when on, sets z=true and builds the relay connection objects (C1TU.java case 21). GlassesMwaRelayConnectionImpl also reads the flag. The non-relay branch is not shown.
wearable_hn_calling.enable_relay_as_tran.change: On: relay path for AI and display glasses. Off: the other path.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_tap_hold_decl.does: Config field enableTapHoldHangupCall (default true). SmartglassesMappings.java:212: during a ringing or active call, when on, tap-and-hold emits KEYCODE_ENDCALL. Otherwise tap-and-hold emits the plain tap-and-hold. wearable_hn_calling.enable_tap_hold_decl.change: Off: a tap-and-hold during a ringing or active call no longer ends the call; it does the plain tap-and-hold.

wearable_hn_calling.enable_updated_call_.does: Chooses the minimised call-view delay: when on, updated_call_ui_minimized_view_timeout (item 20; code default 2000 ms); when off, 15000 ms.
wearable_hn_calling.enable_updated_call_.change: Off: 15000 ms for the minimised view.

wearable_hn_calling.outgoing_call_datax_.does: With item 7 on and an AI-glasses device, this value is read as dataXRpcTimeoutMs, logged in [STEP:FOA_DIALER_TIMEOUTS] and passed to the outgoing-call coroutine (AnonymousClass1). The 0-or-less branch has an empty body in the decompile.

wearable_hn_calling.outgoing_call_reques.does: For AI glasses with item 7 on, this is the outgoing call request timeout (FoADialerEngine.java:1086). If it is 0 or less, the on_hn value (item 16) is used. The value is logged as outgoingCallTimeoutMs.
wearable_hn_calling.outgoing_call_reques.change: On (with item 7): replaces the on_hn value when above 0.

wearable_hn_calling.prioritize_seci_for_.does: PhoneApplication copies this flag into C0Z8.A09. When off, A02 is used, and A04 with the SECI type is added when A02 is blank.
wearable_hn_calling.prioritize_seci_for_.change: On: outgoing WhatsApp participants use A04 with the SECI id type.

wearable_hn_calling.single_press_captouc.does: Config field singlePressCaptouchAnswerCallEnabled (default false). When on and a call is ringing or active, a single tap (keycode 1039) is forwarded to the phone app. When on, a call is active and the device is not interactive, the AVRCP play/pause key is treated as a single tap instead of Mute Mic.
wearable_hn_calling.single_press_captouc.change: On: a single tap during a call goes to the phone app, and play/pause with the screen off acts as a single tap instead of muting the mic. Off: neither happens.

wearable_hn_calling.tap_hold_ends_call_e.does: When a one-finger hold (TAP_HOLD key down) arrives while a call is not ringing and the check A0F(this) passes, the flag decides whether the call ends: when on, InCallViewModel.A0C hangs up and the handler returns true; when off, it returns false.
wearable_hn_calling.tap_hold_ends_call_e.change: On: tap-and-hold hangs up an active call on the glasses.

wearable_hn_calling.updated_call_ui_mini.does: Delay in ms before the minimised call view hides. Used only when enable_updated_call_ui (item 14) is on. Code default 2000 ms.
wearable_hn_calling.updated_call_ui_mini.change: Only matters with the updated call UI on.

wearable_hn_calling.video_bwe_config.does: Text passed as the BWE v1 config JSON to the video sender (setBweV1ConfigJson). The code default is the empty string.
wearable_hn_calling.video_bwe_config.change: Non-empty text replaces the video bandwidth-estimator config.

wearable_hn_calling.video_send_low_bandw.does: Video send bandwidth level in kbps. When above 0, it is mapped to VideoQualityState.WARNING in the video quality map.
wearable_hn_calling.video_send_low_bandw.change: Changes the level at which WARNING is reported.

wearable_impressions.hn_poll_interval_ms.does: Delay in ms before the impression tracker's poll runs after its listeners are attached.

wearable_impressions.hn_visibility_thres.does: Percent of a view that must be on screen for it to count as visible. The tracker compares a view measure from DM.A00(view) with this value.

wearable_motionalgorithms.fall_detection.change: On: the capture session may enable fall detection. Off: it does not.

wearable_phone.filter_spurious_hfp_calls.does: When on and a call is active, an HFP call that starts in the ACTIVE state without a RINGING phase is ignored (logged as 'filtering as spurious'). Within 60000 ms of the holder's creation, such calls are allowed as reconnecting calls. A call whose number was recently active is allowed as a reconnecting call.
wearable_phone.filter_spurious_hfp_calls.change: Off: such calls are not filtered.

wearable_session_monitors_configuration..does: String config for the fuelgauge session monitor (MonitorType.fuelgauge). MonitorManager.applyMobileConfigOverrides() wraps the cached string as a monitor override {"monitors": {"fuelgauge": ...}} (a base64-style encoded string is decoded first) and applies it through MonitorConfigParser.applyOverride(). A rejected override is logged 'Rejected MobileConfig override'. An empty string is reported as status EMPTY.
wearable_session_monitors_configuration..change: Sets the fuelgauge monitor's session configuration from the MobileConfig string instead of the built-in config. The fields of that config were not traced.

wearable_session_monitors_configuration..does: String config for the thermalSkin session monitor (skin temperature). Handled the same way as fuelguage: MonitorManager wraps the cached string as {"monitors": {"thermalSkin": ...}} and applies it through MonitorConfigParser.applyOverride(). The fields of that config were not traced.
wearable_session_monitors_configuration..change: Sets the skin-temperature monitor's session configuration from the MobileConfig string instead of the built-in config. Changing it changes what the thermal monitor is configured to do; the code does not show the effect beyond that.

wearable_settings_converged_sdk.hn_setti.does: When on, RLDriveSettingsSubscriptionService.addAndroidSettingsToRlDriveSubscriptions() starts the Android Settings sync: for each InternalSetting it observes the Android setting and subscribes it to RLDrive. Its dump prints 'Write to RLDrive Enabled' with this value.
wearable_settings_converged_sdk.hn_setti.change: On: Android settings changes are pushed to RLDrive through the subscription service. Off: that sync is not started.

wearable_settings_convergence.enable_rld.does: SettingsAuditTrail.isEnabled() (true if forced or this flag is on). When on, recordChange() records each RLDrive and Android settings change (direction, key, error code) to the audit trail; sensitive keys are written as <redacted>.
wearable_settings_convergence.enable_rld.change: On: each settings sync change is recorded in the audit trail. Off: nothing is recorded.

wearable_system_health.hprof_upload_enab.does: Heap-dump (hprof) upload gate. When config.memory.hprof.enabled is unset, the Hearing app reads this flag. If a leak is found and config.memory.leak is off, the flag being on takes the hprof path: it then checks config.memory.hprof.leak, config.memory.hprof.cooldown and the stored next_leak_upload_time, then the sampling value (item 61), before uploading. The group and audio apps read the same key.
wearable_system_health.hprof_upload_enab.change: On: leak heap dumps may be uploaded (subject to the checks above). Off: no hprof upload from this path. Now off.

wearable_system_health.upload_sampling.does: Percent of leak heap dumps that are uploaded in the Hearing app. 0 or less uploads nothing; 100 or more always passes. Between, a random draw from 0-99 must be below the value to upload.
wearable_system_health.upload_sampling.change: Higher uploads more leak dumps; 0 turns this path off.

wearable_telecom_android_messaging.hn_te.does: SgTelecomMessagingHandler stores this as the native telecom messaging gate (applyGateState) and logs 'MC gate ... = true/false'. isNativeMessagingEnabled returns it. applyGateState also combines it with a second stored flag before setting the handler's state.
wearable_telecom_android_messaging.hn_te.change: On: native telecom messaging is enabled in the handler. Off: not.

wearables_ai_connectivity.retry_app_laun.does: Retry delay in ms. A value of 0 or less takes the skip path, logged as 'RetryAppLaunchDelayMs is <= 0, skipping retry app launch'. A value above 0 is logged as 'Scheduling retry app launch after {}ms if not connected'.

wearables_ai_phone_call.enable_session_i.does: The function that reads this key logs 'SessionIntentHandler is disabled' (SessionIntentHandler.cpp, line 47) on the disabled path. The excerpt does not show what else is skipped.
wearables_ai_phone_call.enable_session_i.change: Off: the session intent handler is disabled, which is logged.

wearables_ai_phone_call.extended_timeout.does: Logged as 'AIPC Extended Timeout MC Enabled: {}'. When it is off, the runtime logs 'Disable AIPC since extended_timeout_mvp_enabled MC is disabled'.
wearables_ai_phone_call.extended_timeout.change: Off: AIPC is disabled in this path, per the log.

wearables_ai_phone_call.followup_ww_endp.does: When the override applies, the runtime logs 'Using MC override for follow-up endpointer: {}ms', so the value is used as the follow-up endpointer time in ms.
wearables_ai_phone_call.followup_ww_endp.change: The follow-up endpointer uses this many ms instead of its default, per the log.

wearables_ai_phone_call.music_playback_d.does: Delay in ms before SgAudioPolicyController resumes media for the ambient state. It is posted with mHandler.postDelayed to maybeResumeMedia(). Read through SgAudioManagerMobileConfigClient.getMusicPlaybackDuringSessionDelayMs(), which defaults to 3000 when unset.
wearables_ai_phone_call.music_playback_d.change: A longer value keeps media paused longer before it resumes; a shorter value resumes sooner.

wearables_ai_phone_call.navigation_remot.does: When navigation remote fulfilment is not enabled, GenericStartIntentHandler logs '[GenericStartIntentHandler]: Navigation remote fulfillment is not enabled' and returns. If the user is not in a navigation dialog it logs '[GenericStartIntentHandler]: User is not in navigation dialog'.
wearables_ai_phone_call.navigation_remot.change: On: navigation start intents do not take the 'not enabled' return (the excerpt shows only the skip path).

wearables_ai_phone_call.sci_comms_enable.does: With a comms provider linked and locale en_US, the runtime logs 'SCI disabled: en_US with comms provider linked and sci_comms_enable off' when this is off. When passthrough is on it logs 'SCI enabled: passthrough enabled, locale: {}'.
wearables_ai_phone_call.sci_comms_enable.change: Off: SCI is disabled for en_US when a comms provider is linked.

wearables_appmanager.companion_install_e.does: The app manager reads persist.sys.smartglass.appmanager_datax_enabled first; if set, it is parsed as the answer. Otherwise it returns the MobileConfig value. If that read throws, it logs 'isCompanionInstallEnabled: MC read failed, using default=false' and returns false.
wearables_appmanager.companion_install_e.change: Off: isCompanionInstallEnabled returns false, unless the persist property is set.

wearables_authentication_sessionless.met.does: When the login is not snoozed and RL.A01(TR.A01) is true, the code posts M3.A00, the repair overlay. Otherwise no overlay is posted.
wearables_authentication_sessionless.met.change: Off: no repair overlay is posted.

wearables_authentication_sessionless.met.does: Sets the snooze cap: max(base snooze, RL.A00(TR.A02) * 60) minutes, so the value is in hours. The snooze is limited to this cap.
wearables_authentication_sessionless.met.change: Lower: the cap drops, but never below the base snooze.

wearables_authentication_sessionless.met.change: Shorter: the overlay returns sooner. Longer: fewer prompts.

wearables_calling_audio.enable_delayed_s.does: Read into mIsDelayedScoFallbackEnabled (default false). shouldRequestScoFallback(b) is true when this is on, the calling state is 2 or 4, the glasses are mounted, and HFP audio is not connected. In that case a runnable is posted to request the SCO fallback (the delay used there was not traced).
wearables_calling_audio.enable_delayed_s.change: On: a calling-state change with the glasses mounted and no HFP audio link requests the SCO fallback. Off: it does not.

wearables_calling_uj_telemetry.enabled.does: The gate C0XZ.A01 guards the journey telemetry calls shown: MainActivityViewModel sends WearableJourneyResult SUCCESS ('incoming_call'), and the hybrid engine sends the 'accepting_call' trigger.

wearables_camera_sg.enable_use_sensor_se.change: Only matters when the property is set false. Then the MC value decides.

wearables_dat.enable_dwa.does: The DAT Wearables App (DWA) gate. DATFeatureGate reads sysprop persist.enable_dwa first, then this value. wearables_dat.enable_dwa.change: On: DAT sessions that request DAM launch the DAT Wearables App. Off: they skip it and report it skipped.

wearables_dat.enable_inputs_action_butto.does: Config field enableDatInputsActionButton (default false). GlobalInputFilterLogic.java:718: during a DAT session with DWA on, the action button key event is routed to the DWA, and the log says 'DAT session active; routing action button to DWA'.
wearables_dat.enable_inputs_action_butto.change: On: action-button presses during a DAT session go to the DAT Wearables App instead of the normal action-button handling.

wearables_dat.enable_inputs_captouch.does: Read through DATFeatureGate (sysprop persist.dat.enable_inputs_captouch overrides) and as config field enableDatInputsCaptouch. With the display off during a DAT session, CaptouchGestureMappingProvider adds mappings for captouch up-events 1045 and 1047 when this is on. SmartglassesMappings checks it for the one-finger double and triple tap mappings.
wearables_dat.enable_inputs_captouch.change: On: captouch double and triple taps are handled in the DAT session mapping. Off: they are not.

wearables_dat.enable_inputs_capture_butt.does: Config field enableDatInputsCaptureButton (default false) and DATFeatureGate persist.dat.enable_inputs_capture_button. isDatCaptureRoutingActive() is true when a DAT session is active, DWA is on and this is on. wearables_dat.enable_inputs_capture_butt.change: On: capture-button presses during a DAT session go to the DAT Wearables App.

wearables_dat.enable_inputs_pinch_and_dr.does: Config field enableDatInputsPinchAndDrag (default false). wearables_dat.enable_inputs_pinch_and_dr.change: On: pinch-and-drag motion from that source goes to the DAT Wearables App during a DAT session.

wearables_dat.gate_session_start_on_don_.change: Off: DAT sessions can start while the glasses are not mounted.

wearables_group_conversations.reconnect_.does: Read in the group session config (C01034s.java:43), clamped to 0..2147483647. It is the second value of KF, passed as the second argument of configParams.
wearables_group_conversations.reconnect_.change: Sets the reconnect value passed to configParams.

wearables_group_conversations.rssi_join_.does: Read in the group session config (C01034s.java:64), clamped to -128..0. It is the fifth value of KF, passed as the fifth argument of configParams.
wearables_group_conversations.rssi_join_.change: Sets the RSSI join value passed to configParams.

wearables_group_conversations.rssi_recon.does: Read in the group session config (C01034s.java:71), clamped to -128..0. It is the sixth value of KF, passed as the sixth argument of configParams.
wearables_group_conversations.rssi_recon.change: Sets the RSSI reconnect value passed to configParams.

wearables_group_conversations.unlock_tim.does: Read in the voice-started request path (IE.java:50), clamped to 0..2147483647 and passed as the timeout argument to SessionManager.A0F. A0F calls setGroupChatLock with that value when no lock change is already in flight.
wearables_group_conversations.unlock_tim.change: Sets the timeout given to the group chat lock change for a voice-started request.

wearables_imagine.runtime_enable_voice_s.does: The assistant runtime reads it as a bool (key 235 via getter 0x155e11c). When it is off, the same block logs '[AssistantMediaGenSharing]: Imagine voice share not enabled', so the Imagine voice share path refuses.
wearables_imagine.runtime_enable_voice_s.change: On lets the Imagine voice share path run.

wearables_input_platform.enable_interact.does: Config field enableInteractionModelMappings (default true). GlobalInputFilterLogic.java:1223-1226: when on, captouch key codes come from SmartglassesMappings.evaluateMappingKeyCode(getCaptouchMapping()); when off, from the older SgInputEventMappingManager.getKeyCodeForCaptouch(). The same flag also picks the mapping path at lines 1394 and 1703-1710.
wearables_input_platform.enable_interact.change: Off: captouch and related gestures use the older mapping table instead of the interaction-model mappings.

wearables_notifications_sdk.use_horizont.does: WearableNotificationService.onMobileConfigChange(): the notification service starts (onStartInternal, which registers it with ServiceManager) when this flag is on or the device resource config_useGnssHardwareProvider is set. The flag value is logged per device.
wearables_notifications_sdk.use_horizont.change: On: the notification service starts on devices where it would not otherwise start.

wearables_ota_core_edition.ceres_ota_ena.does: Read in system_firmwareota and logged as 'WorkflowManager::shouldTriggerEmgOtaAfterAutoOta(): MC ceres_ota_enabled=%d'. The value is kept as the function's result, so it decides whether an EMG OTA follows an auto OTA.
wearables_ota_core_edition.ceres_ota_ena.change: On lets an EMG OTA follow an auto OTA, per the function name and the log.

wearables_ota_core_edition.ota_thermal_c.does: Read as a string in system_firmwareota and parsed by a routine that uses the keys app_ota_start_thermal_with_display, app_ota_start_thermal_without_display, min_storage_mb and resource_ota_runtime_battery_min_charging. Empty now, so the parser's defaults apply (defaults not shown).
wearables_ota_core_edition.ota_thermal_c.change: Setting values sets those keys, which the parser reads.

wearables_ota_core_edition.resource_apk_.does: Read in system_firmwareota. When on, the code tail-calls 0x73180 (the resource verification path). When off, it returns 0 without verifying.
wearables_ota_core_edition.resource_apk_.change: On: resource APKs go through the verification path.

wearables_ota_core_edition.v2_ota_servic.does: Read in AutoOtaJobService.isAutoOtaJobSchedulerEnabled (java:217): below Android 36 the auto OTA job continues only when this is on. Native firmwareota reads it and, when on, logs 'V2 OTA service is enabled, skip v1 Background OTA'.
wearables_ota_core_edition.v2_ota_servic.change: Off: below Android 36 the auto OTA job is not run, and the v1 Background OTA path is not skipped.

wearables_pmc.esrl_cutover_enabled.does: Read as a bool in continuousaicamera_nova (0xe4bec). When it is on and a long read just before (family 0x1685..., compared with #2) equals 2, the code reads wearables_pmc.esrl_window_trigger_ratio (double) and more longs. Otherwise that branch is skipped.
wearables_pmc.esrl_cutover_enabled.change: On reads the ESRL trigger values in the suppression path, but only when the long equals 2 (continuous_ai_camera family, pmc_suppression_type now 2).

wearables_ptt.action_button_mute_unmute_.does: Read in the phone's displayless MainActivity (C0Xb.A00). When on, a key code 1071 (action button) during a call toggles mute (MainActivity.java:565-611). When on, not in a mute-state call and key 1071 or 1092, it logs 'Action button not mapped to mute/unmute during PTT call, not consuming' and returns false (MainActivity.java:621-629).
wearables_ptt.action_button_mute_unmute_.change: Off: the action button mute/unmute handling in those paths is not taken.

wearables_ptt.enabled.does: Read in many PTT paths. In MainActivity.java: a single tap toggles media play/pause for a WhatsApp voice chat when muted (654-665), a double tap skips to the next track (694-705), and the capture-button route checks it (961, 994). Also read in AbstractC02270Vg (99, 162), C0eK (1217) and C0Wl (249).
wearables_ptt.enabled.change: Off: those PTT paths are not taken.

wearables_ptt.force_mute_onboarding.does: Read in C0Wl.java:247 and passed as zA01 into the mute-onboarding fallback (C0eM, line 277). Line 281 branches on it. The debug log at line 264 prints 'forceMuteOnboarding=' with this value.

wearables_ptt.music_triggered_a2dp_enabl.does: Read in C04000gA.java:1406. When on, a music-triggered PTT path calls InCallViewModel requestA2dpProfileSwitch(callId) (C03940fy, lines 586-591) and waits. On timeout it logs 'A2DP profile switch timed out, proceeding with play command'.
wearables_ptt.music_triggered_a2dp_enabl.change: On: the music-triggered PTT path asks for an A2DP profile switch first.

wearables_vip_notifications.enabled.does: When the flag is off, subscription notifications are dropped: the code logs 'VIP notifications disabled, silently dropping subscription notification'.
wearables_vip_notifications.enabled.change: On: this check does not drop subscription notifications.

web_on_hn.webapp_discovery.does: Chooses the store catalogue use case. When true, the StoreCatalogQuery useCase is 'WEB_APP'; when false, 'ALL'. A set persist.appmanager.webapps_only property overrides the flag. An MC read failure logs 'isWebAppsOnlyEnabled: MC read failed, using default=false'.
web_on_hn.webapp_discovery.change: On: the catalogue query asks only for web apps. Off (current): all apps.

wss_appmanager.auto_update_allowlist.does: The list of packages the app manager may auto-update, split on ';'. A system property (persist.experimental.appmanager.auto_update_allowlist) overrides the MC value when set. Packages not on the list are logged as 'Package not in auto-update allowlist' and skipped; the others go on to the batch update.
wss_appmanager.auto_update_allowlist.change: Adding a package lets the app manager auto-update it; removing one makes its updates skip with that log line.

wss_appmanager.hn_allowed_package_list.does: Read by GetUpdateReadinessCommand only when the entitlement payload is present. The package is OK ('entitled and allow-listed') if the list is empty or contains it, and WARN otherwise ('entitled; not in smartglass-store allow-list (display-only, does not block updates)'). A read failure gives an empty set.
wss_appmanager.hn_allowed_package_list.change: Removing a package from the list gives it a WARN readiness check. It does not block updates, as the message says.

wss_appmanager.signature_verification_en.does: When true, the app manager checks each APK's signers before a session install (EX.java hasTrustedSignature). A missing signing info or signer list refuses the install; a signer hash that is not in the trusted set logs 'hasTrustedSignature: no match for ...' and the install is refused with 'APK not signed with trusted key'. The property persist.appmanager.signature_verification overrides the flag.
wss_appmanager.signature_verification_en.change: Off: the whole signer check is skipped, because it sits under the if (zA00) guard.

wss_appmanager.stop_app_manager.does: When true, the app manager stops at once: AppManagerHeadlessApplication.onCreate logs 'kill switch enabled, stopping AppManager' and calls System.exit(0); AppManagerService.onBind refuses to bind and calls stopSelf; the binder's getAppInfo path logs 'kill switch enabled, refusing request' instead of answering. A set persist.appmanager.stop_app_manager property overrides the flag.
wss_appmanager.stop_app_manager.change: On: the app manager exits on start and refuses binds and getAppInfo requests.
